signature: SUBROUTINE DTRSEN( JOB, COMPQ, SELECT, N, T, LDT, Q, LDQ, WR, WI,

params.name: job
compq
params.reference:
-   `= 'V'`: update the matrix Q of Schur vectors;
-   `= 'N'`: do not update Q.

params.name: SELECT
params.reference: `SELECT` specifies the eigenvalues in the selected cluster. To select a real eigenvalue w(j), `SELECT(j)` must be set to .TRUE.. To select a complex conjugate pair of eigenvalues w(j) and w(j+1), corresponding to a 2-by-2 diagonal block, either `SELECT(j)` or `SELECT(j+1)` or both must be set to .TRUE.; a complex conjugate pair of eigenvalues must be either both included in the cluster or both excluded.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: T
params.reference: On entry, the upper quasi-triangular matrix T, in Schur canonical form. On exit, T is overwritten by the reordered matrix T, again in Schur canonical form, with the selected eigenvalues in the leading diagonal blocks.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, the matrix Q of Schur vectors. On exit, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, Q has been postmultiplied by the orthogonal transformation matrix which reorders T; the leading M columns of Q form an orthonormal basis for the specified invariant subspace. If `COMPQ = 'N'`, Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$; and if `COMPQ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$.

params.name: WI
params.reference: The real and imaginary parts, respectively, of the reordered eigenvalues of T. The eigenvalues are stored in the same order as on the diagonal of T, with `WR(i) = T(i,i)` and, if `T(i:i+1,i:i+1)` is a 2-by-2 diagonal block, $\mathrm{WI}(i) > 0$ and `WI(i+1) = -WI(i)`. Note that if a complex eigenvalue is sufficiently ill-conditioned, then its value may differ significantly from its value before reordering.

params.name: m
params.reference: The dimension of the specified invariant subspace. 0 \< = $M \le N$.

params.name: s
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', S is a lower bound on the reciprocal condition number for the selected cluster of eigenvalues. S cannot underestimate the true reciprocal condition number by more than a factor of sqrt(N). If $M = 0$ or N, $S = 1$. If `JOB = 'N'` or 'V', S is not referenced.

params.name: sep
params.reference: If `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', `SEP` is the estimated reciprocal condition number of the specified invariant subspace. If $M = 0$ or N, `SEP = norm(T)`. If `JOB = 'N'` or 'E', `SEP` is not referenced.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `JOB = 'N'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `JOB = 'E'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M \, (N-M))$; if `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, M \, (N-M))$.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `IWORK(1)` returns the optimal `LIWORK`.

params.name: liwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `IWORK`. If `JOB = 'N'` or 'E', $\mathrm{LIWORK} \ge 1$; if `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LIWORK} \ge \max (1,M \, (N-M))$.

If `LIWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `IWORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `IWORK` array, and no error message related to `LIWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `= 1`: reordering of T failed because some eigenvalues are too close to separate (the problem is very ill-conditioned); T may have been partially reordered, and `WR` and `WI` contain the eigenvalues in the same order as in T; S and `SEP` (if requested) are set to zero.

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local LWMIN is assigned inside nested control flow
IWORK.minLength: local LIWMIN is assigned inside nested control flow
